popup.title: Lonely Lake
popup.description: A small oasis found within the [[Plains of Purple Dust]] in [[east Faerûn]] and the [[Hordelands]].

popup.title: Grinning Skull Oasis
popup.description: The oasis, named because it was shielded from the harsh wind by the skull of a long-dead great [[dragon]].

popup.title: Lion's Eye Oasis
popup.description: The lushest of the oases found in the entirety of the desert; at its center was a small lake encircled by ascending grasslands dotted with wildflowers and large boulders.

popup.title: Hlaunga
popup.description: A secret, [[Zhentarim]]-manufactured oasis that served as a waypoint for Zhent caravans that traveled across the [[Great Grand Sea]] via the [[Black Road]].

popup.title: Bitter Well
popup.description: An oasis occupied by the [[Zhentarim]] spellcaster [[Yhekal]] in the late 14{{th}} century [[DR]].

popup.title: Colored Waters
popup.description: A grand oasis and settlement in [[Anauroch]], home of the [[Mahwa]] tribe of the [[Bedine]] people.

popup.title: El Ma'ra
popup.description: An oasis and a settlement found in the [[Anauroch]] desert, home to the [[Qahtan]] tribe the [[Bedine]] people.

popup.title: Well of the Chasm
popup.description: A deep canyon within the [[Scimitar Spires]] with a source of fresh water found within its depths.

popup.title: Well of the Cloven Rock
popup.description: A popular oasis located in the [[Hills of Scent]] with a crescent-shaped lake, surrounded by many varieties of t[[ree]]s, within a grass-filled, bowl-shaped valley in the hills.

popup.title: Sister of Rains
popup.description: A canyon-oasis used as a refuge for those [[Bedine]] who were outcasts from their tribes, such as [[witch]]es, [[wizard]]s, and other spellcasters.

popup.title: Bhaerlith
popup.description: A secret, manufactured oasis rich with a variety of fruiting [[tree]]s, within an underground stone structure used by the [[Zhentilar]] soldiers.

popup.title: Vuerthyl
popup.description: An artificially-created oasis in the [[Anauroch]] created by the [[Zhentarim]] via a ''[[decanter of endless water]]''.

popup.title: Olomaa
popup.description: An artificially-created oasis splayed out over two hills and the valley that lay tween them utilized by the [[Zhentarim]].

popup.title: Yliyl
popup.description: A minor oasis found in [[the Sword]] comprised a small pool of water surrounded by some palm trees and desert shrubs.

popup.title: The Oasis of Vipers
popup.description: An old, well-watered set of three pools in [[Anauroch]] that was mostly ignored by the [[Bedine]].

popup.title: Ma'atar
popup.description: An artificially created, [[Zhentarim]]-controlled oasis beneath which were tunnels that stored an arsenal of supplies, weapons, and magical armaments.
